value: paired chiastic clipping signal
quote: In contrast to other annotation- or circRNA enrichment-dependent algorithms, this method employs a novel algorithm based on paired chiastic clipping (PCC) signal detection in the Sequence Alignment/Map (SAM) of BWA-MEM combined with systematic filtering to remove false positives.

value: paired-end mapping
quote: Preliminary filtering is implemented using paired-end mapping (PEM) and GT-AG splicing signals for the junctions.

value: circular junction
quote: Because circRNAs are characterized by circular junctions, which resemble splicing and usually produce multiple alignments during read mapping, these mature mapping algorithms may provide large improvements in accuracy and efficiency and may make unbiased detection of circRNAs possible.

value: intronic circRNA fragment
quote: The three intronic circRNA fragments (ICFs) are 100 bp, 170 bp and 71 bp long, respectively, and they are all flanked by GT-AG splicing signals.
